releaseNotes:
🚀 v1.9.0 Major Release: Native In-App Billing & 1-Tap Minute Packs
• 💳 Saved Card Vaulting: View and manage your vaulted card securely inside the app
• ⚡ 1-Tap Minute Reloads: Add 40 minutes for $10 instantly with zero web redirects
• 🔄 Auto-Billing Refill Engine: Automatically recharge minutes when balance drops below threshold during calls
• 🎙️ Standard $9.99/mo Voice Management: Native subscribe and cancel controls
• 🌐 Global Unified Navigation: Consistent responsive menu and smooth scrolling across all web portals
